svg.title: A unit circle crossing an interface meets both of its colours
svg.desc: A short vertical segment K with a strip of colour A on its left and a strip of colour B on its right. A point z to the lower left straddles K. Part of the unit circle around z is drawn dashed; it crosses K at a point q strictly between the ends of K, with a red ruler of length 1 from z to q. Just below q the circle runs through the A strip (thick blue) and just above q through the B strip (thick green).

g.text: A circle that crosses an interface meets both colours
Model: colour A on one side of the segment K, colour B on the other.
it runs through A or B
Near q the circle runs through both A and B, so z is robust in neither colour.
